page.overview:
What is Adventure Withered Freddy?

is an unlockable titular character in FNaF World.

Withered Freddy is similar in appearance to his core series counterpart, although he is much smaller and appears to have darker fur. Unlike the other Withered animatronics, Withered Freddy does not have many rips and tears on his body, only having one major rip on his left thigh. In addition, he has some wires poking out from his suit in a few places on his body. He has gray-ish pupils that appear to be glowing white, albeit faintly. His attack animation shows him leaning forward and enlarging his head.

Withered Freddy is a decent character, working best as support. Mic Toss is his only actual attack move, although it is fairly weak and overshadowed by other stronger moves that the player should have access to by the time they unlock Withered Freddy.

However, Withered Freddy can lower enemies' attack with Gloom Song, although this is only temporary.
